name: Blizzard
rationale: Snow and Ice establish cold, a feather carries the weather, and Powder spreads it through an Emerald-directed field.

parts.rationale: Native cold substitute for Iron Frozen Bone

clues: Outer Plinths hold powder motif, cold focus; the other required ingredients use Inner Plinths.
Leave the first outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Leave the third outer Plinth clockwise from Paper empty.
Evocation focus follows blank inscription clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Powder motif follows evocation focus clockwise.
Feather motif follows powder motif clockwise.
Ice motif follows feather motif clockwise, across an unused outer Plinth.
Cold focus follows ice motif clockwise.
Blank inscription follows cold focus clockwise.
